name: Salmon River (Salmon)
blurb: The upper Salmon River between the City of Salmon and North Fork, with designated boating access and a Highway 93 shuttle.

sections.notes: Use the City of Salmon Island Park ramps and the designated IDFG access at North Fork, with a Highway 93 shuttle. North Fork is at the North Fork tributary, not the Middle Fork confluence. Check current flows, obstructions and usable landings before a trip.
sections.routeReview: The river changes around gravel bars and islands. The access areas are shown, but a dependable dotted course for the full stretch is still being checked.

notices.title: Daylight takeout access
notices.text: North Fork boat access is available through an Idaho Fish and Game/private land lease and is for daylight use only. Adjacent campsites and picnic sites are private. Island Park in Salmon is open 6 a.m.–10 p.m.
notices.sourceName: Idaho Fish and Game — North Fork and Island Park

putInAccess.sourceName: Idaho Fish and Game public boating access inventory
putInAccess.note: IDFG site 264 identifies this City of Salmon facility with two boat ramps. The agency coordinate marks the park/ramp vicinity, not a specific shoreline entry. The park is open 6 a.m.–10 p.m.; IDFG lists running-water restrooms March 1–November 30. No camping.
putInAccess.directions: Use City of Salmon Island Park and its designated boat ramps. This is Island Park in Lemhi County, not Island Park Reservoir in Fremont County. Confirm the suitable ramp and parking at the park.

takeOutAccess.operator: Idaho Fish and Game / private access lease
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Idaho Fish and Game public boating access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: IDFG site 295 lists an active boat ramp and a public-access lease at North Fork. Approximate facility area only. Daylight use only; adjacent campsites and picnic sites are private. This is North Fork on the upper Salmon, not the remote Middle Fork confluence.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the designated North Fork boat access behind the North Fork Store and Campground off US Highway 93. This public access is provided through an Idaho Fish and Game/private land lease. Stay within the signed access area.

mapAuditNote: Official public boating access, named facility identities and approximate areas checked separately from river-course geometry. Approved sections have individual reviews; dotted lines require independent full-course checks.
